about:
About this property

Brigade Eternia is a premium residential project by Brigade Group, located in Yelahanka, North Bengaluru. Spread across approximately 14 acres 1124 Units + 12 Towers, the development offers spacious 3, 3.5, and 4.5 BHK apartments. The project stands out for its lush green design, with nearly 80% open spaces, landscaped gardens, and wide internal roads. Strategically situated near Bellary Road and close to schools, tech parks, malls, and Kempegowda International Airport, Brigade Eternia ensures excellent connectivity and a peaceful environment. The project features over 40 modern amenities, including a grand clubhouse, swimming pools, gym, mini-theatre, indoor and outdoor sports courts, meditation zones, pet parks, and a skating rink. Apartments come with premium finishes, smart home features, modular kitchens, and well-ventilated floor plans with large balconies.
